synPrintEntity

synPrintEntity.Rd

Pretty print an Entity as JSON.

Usage

synPrintEntity(entity, ensure_ascii=TRUE, synapse_client=NULL)

Arguments

entity

(Union[str, dict, Dataset, DatasetCollection, EntityView, File, Folder, Link, MaterializedView, Project, RecordSet, SubmissionView, Table, VirtualTable]) Either an Entity object (Dataset, DatasetCollection, EntityView, File, Folder, Link, MaterializedView, Project, RecordSet, SubmissionView, Table, VirtualTable), a Synapse ID string, or a named list representation of an entity.

ensure_ascii

(bool) If TRUE, escapes all non-ASCII characters in the output. Defaults to TRUE.

synapse_client

(Optional[Synapse]) If not passed in, the last created instance from the Synapse class constructor will be used.

Value

NULL. Prints the entity to the logger.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Printing an entity by ID
    # Print an entity using its Synapse ID:
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Print entity by Synapse ID
    synPrintEntity("syn123456")

## Example 2: Printing an entity object
    # Print an entity object:
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Get and print a file entity
    file = synGet(synapse_id = "syn123456")
    synPrintEntity(file)

## Example 3: Controlling ASCII output
    # Print an entity with non-ASCII characters:
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Print with unicode characters preserved
    synPrintEntity("syn123456", ensure_ascii = FALSE)
} # }
